tool_input.command: export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec117/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && S=plugins/system-spec-harness; D="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/system-spec"; python3 -B $S/scripts/validate-coverage-matrix.py --matrix "$D/spec-state.json" --require-complete --require-basis --require-foundation >/dev/null; a=$?; python3 -B $S/scripts/validate-source-citation.py --targets "$D/spec-state.json" --references "$D/fetched-references.json" --state "$D/spec-state.json" --repo-root "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >/dev/null; b=$?; python3 -B plugins/dev-graph/scripts/validate-graph-schema.py --graph "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.dev-graph/state/graph.json" --repo-root "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" --strict-artifact-readiness; c=$?; echo "coverage=$a citation=$b schema=$c"; python3 -c 'import hashlib,json,sys; g=json.load(open(sys.argv[1],encoding="utf-8")); print(g["graph_revision"], "sha256:"+hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(g,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()).hexdigest())' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.dev-graph/state/graph.json"; sha256sum system-spec/index.md system-spec/00-requirements-definition.md 2>/dev/null || shasum -a 256 system-spec/index.md system-spec/00-requirements-definition.md
